name: gil-companion-prototype
description: Record reasoning with GIL, and keep the journey visible in the GIL Monitor.

interface.shortDescription: Record your reasoning with GIL and keep the journey visible.
interface.longDescription: Carries GIL itself — open and close steps, read context and status, restore or revisit — and opens the persistent GIL Monitor so a human can watch the journey. The Monitor is read-only: it never writes to your project.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open the GIL Companion window and keep it visible while we continue.
